description: Check a preheader (the preview text after the subject in the inbox). Pass `html` (the email; the first hidden block at the top of the body is read) or `preheader` text directly, and optionally `subject`. Checks: missing preheader, length (under about 40 characters lets the client pull in body text; over about 110 to 140 gets cut, both estimates and client dependent), repeating the subject, filler such as 'View in browser', padding characters to push body text out, and whether the hiding method is sound. Email client support notes are from our own testing notes dated 2026-10 and may have drifted. Confirm in real clients (Litmus, Email on Acid, or seed accounts) before sending.

html.description: Email HTML (or leave blank and pass preheader)

preheader.description: Preheader text, if not passing HTML

name: check_email_preheader
title: Email preheader check
